question: An interface between the human user and the computer hardware is known as: ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**operating system.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operating system**

 
 
• An Operating System (OS) is a n interface between a computer user and computer hardware.
 
• It is software that performs all the basic tasks like file management, memory management, process management, etc.
 
• It is software that enables applications to interact with a computer's hardware.
 
• The software that contains the core components of the operating system is called the kernel.
 
• Some popular Operating Systems include **Linux** Operating System,** Windows** Operating System**, MAC, Ubuntu.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Software**

 
 
• Software is a set of instructions, data or programs used to operate computers and execute specific tasks.
 
• It is the opposite of hardware, which describes the physical aspects of a computer.
 
• Software is a generic term used to refer to applications, scripts and programs that run on a device.
 
• It can be thought of as the variable part of a computer, while the hardware is the invariable part.
 
 
 
• **Modem**
 
 
• Modem stands for** Modulator and Demodulator.**
 
• It is a device that modulates signals to encode digital information.
 
• A modem transmits data in bits per second (bps).
 
• It converts the digital signal to Analog and vice versa to communicate between devices.
 
• It encodes the signal and decodes at the other end and vice versa between the devices.
